newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Straits gets S$13.6 mln land compensation.
newsitem.headline: Straits gets S$13.6 mln land compensation.

text.p: Investment company Straits Trading Co Ltd said on Thursday the Singapore government had agreed to pay it Singapore $13.66 million for a parcel of land acquired in July 1990.

It said in a statement the government had made a supplementary award of S$13.54 million plus interest at six percent per annum with effect from February 8, 1992, the date of possession, to the date of payment in full.
It said the award would be treated as an extraordinary item. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
